message: Hong Kong form: the catalog follows Taiwan usage: 工作階段, 資料, 介面, 網路, 執行緒, 快取, 列印, 胺基酸, 軟體, 註解 (STYLE 4.3).
The Language menu entry is plain 繁體中文, with no 台灣 suffix (Owner, 2026-10-19).
Traditional Chinese quotes with 「」, nested 『』 (STYLE 4.2).
Write … (U+2026), not three ASCII periods.
Write ASCII digits 0-9.
No space between Chinese and digits: 10筆記錄 (STYLE 4.2 / 3.3).
Diagram mode Linear is 線狀; only the Record Size Mode option Linear is 線性 (STYLE 4.5).
No space follows 。 between two sentences (D-18).
